title: Decision-diagram compilers, full MCC 2020–2026
about: All 1,400 MCC 2020–2026 track-1 entries, 120 s per instance. Both compiler comparisons use the same saved and validated tididi-cnf measurements. BDD and SDD packages materialize their diagrams in memory.

title: Logic-circuit compilers (saved circuits), full MCC 2020–2026
about: All 1,400 MCC 2020–2026 track-1 entries, 120 s per instance, using one fixed input representative per distinct formula for every tool. Circuit files are written within the time limit and validated after timing.

title: Model counters, MCC 2020–2026, two minutes
about: tididi-cnf and the latest exact competition entries across MCC 2020–2026, two minutes per instance. Every competition entry is included; repeated formulas use one fixed representative.

title: Model counters, 2026 private, one hour
about: The same counters for an hour per instance on the 100 private instances of 2026; the 33 instances that no solver had finished before were not run and count as unsolved.
